text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...Even though McQueen-san warned me earlier.
I focused too much on Kita-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Maybe I paid too much attention to Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
So both Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black
missed out on 1st place, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, clawing her way back up from here with pure grit
is what our Kitasan is all about!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond still has plenty of room to grow. She won't let things end with a defeat!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The result was a shame, but both Kita-chan
and Dia-chan have really grown so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From whose perspective are you speaking...?
Though, I do agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them race
kind of reminded me of our head-to-head match.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring), isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... the next race for those two as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so~.
...By the way, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a reeeeeeally, really big mood
to run right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence.
I am as well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wanna run all the way back to the station?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Dia-chan, this... this isn't like us at all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Kita-chan.
There can be no true settlement without a complete victory.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)!!
That's where I want to face off against Dia-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)...
That's the race where Kita-chan's back-to-back victory is on the line, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! 3,200 meters—the longest GⅠ.
If we're doing this, let's set off some spectacular fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Talk it over with your Trainer and think about it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting in Kyoto!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, about the next race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...But why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond said that while chasing after
Kitasan Black, she wants to ponder
what it truly means to be a "legendary Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I had anticipated entering
the races that Kitasan Black is aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I figured Satono Diamond would intentionally
challenge Kitasan Black in the Tenno Sho (Spring)—
a race where Kitasan excels and is aiming for consecutive wins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you see right through everything.
...Hm, then it seems there should be no problem with me making on-the-spot decisions from now on.
choice_data_list: No, at least consult me first?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Today's defeat made me realize that I lack the strength to ever be called a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This time, I'll take 1st place in the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And I shall bring home the historic Shield,
along with its glory, to House Satono!
